title: Slice-driven robustness evaluation and rollback signal for batching + KV cache config changes
creator: Aisha Raman
description: We need an automated evaluation harness that quantifies latency vs. quality robustness for proposed batching and KV-cache config changes, and synthesizes a conservative rollback signal. Unlike prior broad frontier scans, this ticket focuses on slice-driven sampling to detect brittle regressions that affect small but important user slices (e.g., long-context prompts, instruction-heavy templates, multi-turn chat). Deliverables: (1) eval harness executing stochastic slice sampling across workload partitions, (2) metrics and an aggregated robustness index, (3) automated rollback/QA signal that can be surfaced in CI and the Console. This work ties into the regression-monitoring pipeline and will be used before and after rollout of runtime config changes.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run a reproducible 10k-sample evaluation with slice-driven sampling in <=3 hours on CI hardware
Produce per-slice metrics: median latency, p95 latency, generation quality (ROUGE-L, BLEU when applicable), embedding-similarity stability, and a composite robustness score

Define a rollback signal with clear thresholds (e.g., >10% drop in composite score on any high-priority slice OR >30ms p95 increase on high-latency-sensitive slice) and wire it to the pre-rollout gate
Results are uploaded to the eval dashboard and linked to build artifacts and a GitHub PR status check
Documentation and runbook added to Confluence with steps for on-call and SRE to triage failures
steps: Assemble workloads: canonical prompt sets (chat, summarization, Q&A), long-context synthetic traces, and customer-derived slices sampled from prod traces anonymized in the pipeline
Implement stochastic slice sampler: weighted sampling over slice keys (prompt length, role, model family, tokenization edge cases) with deterministic seeds for reproducibility
Run config grid: baseline config + N proposed configs for batching/kvcache (microbatch sizes, ttl, eviction policy, prefix-cache warm thresholds)
Collect metrics: per-request timing breakdown (routing, queueing, model infer), token-level quality deltas, embedding drift, and failure/error rates
Compute composite robustness index: weighted aggregator (latency penalty + quality degradation + error spike) with configurable weights per project
Implement rollback signal: evaluate thresholds, produce machine-readable outcome (PASS/WARN/FAIL) and human-readable summary with top 3 affected slices
Integrate with CI: runner job that triggers before canary rollout and posts status to GitHub and Console rollout view
